title: A Folded-Channel MOSFET for Deep-Sub-Tenth Micron Era

passages.locator: Printed p. 1032, structure, features, measurements and reference [1]; p. 1033, Fig. 1
passages.note: The demonstration uses a short silicon fin with gates on both sides aligned to each other and to elevated source and drain. The authors call the design a variant of earlier vertical double-gate SOI MOSFETs and cite Hitachi’s DELTA work.

lineage: Original conference paper in a public USPTO exhibit.
